slides.title: Value is a decision, not a slogan.
slides.sub: How one framework became the strategic foundation of a company.

paras: Most value propositions live on slide 3 of a pitch deck. They sound right and decide nothing.
At jambit I developed a value proposition framework for single products and for the company as a whole.
slides.title: Does it tell you what to say no to?

slides.html:
One logic, two levels
The same question at every level.
Product level
Why should this customer choose this product over the alternative?
Company level
Why should this market choose this company over the alternative?

slides.title: From slogan to filter
slides.before: A value line in the deck. Every request still sounds reasonable.
slides.after: Shared language. Every roadmap item names the value it serves.
slides.punch: Strategy is what you stop building.

slides.title: A value proposition earns its place when it helps you say no.
slides.sub: In banking, health and energy, that is the line between a roadmap and a wish list.
slides.sign: I design products that cannot afford to fail.
